name: Inglewood Investment Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA
  Wednesday, June 3, 2020
  1:00 P.M.

  Web Sites:
  www.cityofinglewood.org

  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  INGLEWOOD INVESTMENT COMMITTEE
  (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD INVESTMENT COMMITTEE

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Chairman and Member that a special meeting of the
Inglewood Investment Committee will be held on Wednesday, June 3, 2020, commencing at 1:00
P.M., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government
Code Section 54956).

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Pursuant to Executive N-29-20, which suspends
portions of the Brown Act, and given the current health concerns, members of the public who wish to address the
Inglewood Investment Committee can submit their public comments electronically to investment-
committee@cityofinglewood.org for consideration. To ensure the distribution of the comments to the Committee
prior to consideration, please submit your comments no later than 2 hours prior to the start of the meeting. Contact
the Deputy to the City Manager at 310-412-5282 with any further questions or concerns.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with
Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in
implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, in
order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation,
aid, or service by contacting the Deputy to the City Manager by telephone at 310-412-5282 or via email to
ydecatur@cityofingelwood.org no later than 1 hour before the scheduled meeting.

INVESTMENT COMMITTEE CHAIRMAN
 James T. Butts, Jr., Mayor
INVESTMENT COMMITTEE MEMBERS
 Wanda M. Brown, City Treasurer
 Artie Fields, City Manager
 Sharon Koike, Asst. Finance Director (Designee)
 Yakema Decatur, Secretary

  CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS REMARKS

  ADJOURNMENT INGLEWOOD INVESTMENT COMMITTEE
